risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (321.12) indicates extreme market stress, rising DXY pressures multinational consumer discretionary, and earnings in 27 days adds event risk to already toxic environment.

debate.key_bull_argument: Extreme oversold RSI (9) with stochastic bullish cross and long-term EMA alignment (50/200) offer contrarian bounce setup in fear-driven market (16/100 fear index).
